title: Vs Impostor D-Sides
description: This mod adds various features to Minecraft, all relating to the Friday Night Funkin mod Vs Impostor D-Sides
body:
Note: **_This mod will be later accumulated into another mod when said mods finished!_**

**This is a mod that adds over 100 various features related to the Friday Night Funkin mod, [Vs Impostor D-Sides](https://gamebanana.com/mods/419998)! You will be able to come across crewmates, impostors, and even some silly dinasaurs scattered about your world!**

![Render](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/890a43e33081f3d1014c00604b9d45c8329c1da5_0.webp)
------
## **Guide**
Throughout the world, you will be able to find various structures, and the Florassic Forest. The structures are the places you will be able to come across the crewmates and impostors of this mod. The Florassic Forest contains a few of these structures, a new neon-cyan wood type, and more! As well as all the Florassic forest resources, you can also use drops from the impostors and crewmates, as well as loot from the structures to craft various items!

## **Credits**
- Sabothunder Team - Creator of Vs Impostor D-Sides, concepting
- [AirArcher](https://modrinth.com/user/AirArcher) - Painting artist

Other note: **_This mod has no relation to the D-Sides Creeper mod I have also released, this mod even has its own take on a D-Sides Creeper._**
